name: Home underdog ATS
signal_component: Model predicts home underdog covers the spread; edge = model margin minus market line
signal_vs_staking_note: Signal (cover probability) is separated from staking (flat unit); a lucky staking run cannot lift a negative-signal strategy
what_would_change_our_mind: A verified closing price history that shows the model beat the market line (G4) and a chronological holdout win rate clearly above break-even with a game-cluster lower bound (G3)

name: Home dog +7 or more

what_would_change_our_mind: A verified market price history + holdout pass; without it the 56.37%/n=793 result cannot be certified (Bonferroni p=0.0134 > alpha 0.00625)
